Previously, after discovering that WhatsApp is developing new chat themes, this feature is now officially rolled out to iPhone users. Here are the details.

WhatsApp's new chat themes add dynamic backgrounds

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is now launching five new chat theme categories: Featured, Nature, Dynamic, Minimal, and Doodle. Two weeks ago, the website discovered references to a new theme collection in the code.

The website pointed out that the Featured category includes the "best theme combinations" curated by the WhatsApp design team; the Nature category "offers themes that bring outdoor scenery into the chat screen." The Dynamic category "adds slowly moving wallpapers to the background," while the Minimal theme "sets the chat screen to a solid color background: white for light mode, black for dark mode." As for the Doodle category, these are WhatsApp's classic wallpapers with doodle patterns.

Below is WABetaInfo's introduction to dynamic wallpapers, arguably the most noteworthy new feature:

WABetaInfo stated that WhatsApp will automatically match chat bubble colors based on the selected theme, and noted that as with other WhatsApp feature rollouts, the new feature may not be immediately available to all users.
